title: some .winmd files not signed
summary: The unsigned metadata inventory is covered by open signing PR #51295; wait for its review, merge, production signing, and release validation rather than proposing a competing fix.
next_action: Track PR #51295 through merge and confirm the affected metadata is signed in a released package.

judgment.rationale: The issue's eleven unsigned .winmd filenames match the files added to release signing policies in PR #51295, which also adds independent metadata-signature validation for MSI and the embedded Command Palette MSIX. The PR is open, not merged, and references #51226; this is covered work in progress, not a resolved defect.
evidence: The reporter lists BackgroundActivator, CalculatorEngineCommon, PowerToys.GPOWrapper, PowerToys.Interop, PowerToys.ZoomItSettingsInterop, Microsoft.CommandPalette.Extensions, PowerRenameUI, PowerToys.FileLocksmithLib.Interop, PowerToys.MeasureToolCore, PowerToys.PowerAccentKeyboardService, and SkiaSharp.Views.WinUI.Native .winmd files as unsigned.

Open PR #51295 adds those PowerToys metadata names to signing policies (including WinUI3Apps copies), adds SkiaSharp metadata signing, and validates metadata signatures in the MSI and embedded Command Palette package.
PR #51295 references open issue #51226 and is not merged or evidence that the present installed release is corrected.
Issue #51642 is open, unassigned, labeled Issue-Bug/Needs-Triage, and has no comments.
judgment.recommended_action: Do not start a parallel fix. Follow PR #51295 and verify the corresponding signed payload after merge and release.

issue_context.summary: The report identifies eleven unsigned Windows Runtime metadata files in PowerToys 0.102.3001 and notes publisher allowlisting can block them.

The PR is not merged, so no release-level resolution is established.
issue_context.analysis: The exact filename coverage makes #51295 the in-flight remediation path. Production signing and a released-package check remain outstanding; retain this issue as corroborating impact instead of starting another design.
